drop_rules: Each enemy spawn def (+0x14) points at [on_death_fn, script]. on_death_fn 0x0801069b runs the script with the script VM (0x080092e4) when the enemy dies: L0=rand(100); then rows are tested in order, first match drops the item at the enemy position (sub-op 0x57 -> 0x0800aba5 -> pickup ctor 0x08011802). A row whose condition fails falls through to the next row (so e.g. L0<2 with full HP can still yield the EP row). 0x08010699 = no drop; 0x080106b3 = scripted event instead of drops.
